item.title: Tibber Menu Bar 0.2.0
item.description:
## 0.2.0
- Automatic updates: the app now checks once a day and installs new versions itself (Sparkle). Settings → General → Check for Updates… - Hover the price tile for the energy and tax breakdown. - Solar: homes that feed power into the grid see the net power, today's export, and a yellow gauge. - Colorblind-friendly level colors (Settings → Prices → Level colors). - Clock times follow your macOS locale. - Settings survive upgrades that add new options. - macOS 14 or later. Signed but not notarized: allow it once under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
